author: Codex
name: Library Tweaks
description: Small tweaks for the native Zen Library. Currently adds Saves (bookmarks), Easels and Media sections.

background/urlbar.sys.mjs.name: Saves urlbar provider
background/urlbar.sys.mjs.description: Natural-language bookmark search in the urlbar. Imported once per process.

features/saves.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - Saves
features/saves.uc.js.description: Saves (bookmarks) section for the native Zen Library.

features/easels.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - Easels
features/easels.uc.js.description: Easels section for the native Zen Library.

features/media.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - Media
features/media.uc.js.description: Media section for the native Zen Library.

features/tweak-history.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - History menu
features/tweak-history.uc.js.description: Right-click options for native History items.

features/tweak-anim.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - Section animation
features/tweak-anim.uc.js.description: Entrance animation when switching library sections.

features/tweak-boosts.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - Boosts UI
features/tweak-boosts.uc.js.description: Grouped, tiled Boosts presentation for the native section.

features/tweak-spaces.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - Spaces extras
features/tweak-spaces.uc.js.description: Drop indicator and new-space button for native Spaces.

features/tweak-downloads.uc.js.name: Library Tweaks - Downloads extras
features/tweak-downloads.uc.js.description: On-device files group and rename support for native Downloads.
